test_lrscheduler_step: test the LRScheduler.step method that increments the epoch and updates parameter group learning rates
create_steplr_scheduler: create a StepLR scheduler that decays learning rate by gamma every step_size epochs
create_cosine_annealing_lr: create a CosineAnnealingLR scheduler that applies cosine annealing schedule with T_max iterations and eta_min minimum learning rate
create_reduce_lr_on_plateau: create a ReduceLROnPlateau scheduler that reduces learning rate when a monitored metric stops improving after patience epochs
create_sequential_lr_scheduler: create a SequentialLR scheduler that chains multiple schedulers called sequentially at specified milestone epochs
